title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony, out since May with a wrist injury, is training with high-velocity pitching to prepare for return.
Adley Rutschman, acquired from the Orioles, made a rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, catching five innings.
The Red Sox anticipate lineup boosts with Anthony and Rutschman's returns, as they hold a 9-game winning streak.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix presents Alicia Silverstone's classic 'Clueless' and Bo Burnham's 'Eighth Grade' as August highlights.
Paramount+ releases 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' featuring Dave Bautista as an ancient warrior awakened.
Peacock offers new titles including the comedy-drama 'The Ballad of Wallis Island' starring Tim Key.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
There have been 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England since 1994, investigated by the BFRO's 3,000 members.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett remains skeptical, citing a lack of scientific evidence for the existence of Bigfoot.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of advice columnist Ann Landers, passed away at 86 in July.
Howard wrote advice columns such as 'Dear Prudence' for Slate and 'Dear Margo' for The Boston Globe.
Meredith Goldstein reflects on Howard's influence, emphasizing her practical advice on balancing grief with happiness.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox extend their winning streak to nine games with a 13-1 victory over the Athletics.
Pitcher Payton Tolle hits a career-high 14 strikeouts in six innings with no walks.
Boston's offense gathers 15 hits, including a two-run homer by Jarren Duran, contributing to the win.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are enhancing their skills against each other during New England Patriots training camp.
Gonzalez, who is known for his professionalism, engages in strategic trash talk to prepare Brown for the season.
New England Patriots are expected to offer Gonzalez a lucrative contract amid his training participation and search for a new deal.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman to start a rehab assignment with the Triple-A Worcester Red Sox on Saturday.
Rutschman, acquired from the Orioles, is recovering from left wrist inflammation, out since July 18.
Rutschman was a 2026 All-Star; he's expected to bolster the Red Sox's roster upon full recovery.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' (2026) streams on Paramount+; it's a continuation of the Nickelodeon series.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 features the coach leading a women's football team, available on Apple TV.
'You, Me & Tuscany' stars Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page, streaming on Peacock.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet could return to the Red Sox bullpen in 2026 due to ongoing injury recovery.
Interim manager Chad Tracy considers Crochet's bullpen role possible, given uncertainty about his starting capability.
Crochet, recovering from shoulder and lat injuries, supports any role to contribute to the team's success.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester, Boston.
Boston Animal Care and Control retrieved the snake after it was left in a community garden.
Officials are seeking information on the snake's owner; contact them at 617-635-1800.
